repository_scope.legacy_note: The retained Chimera Spectral Perception System repository remains migration evidence for the Vision Evidence Governed Multimodal Perception Framework and is not double-counted as a separate canonical asset.

replacements.name: Continuum State Integrity Platform
replacements.summary: A deterministic state-integration and integrity research platform with contradiction analysis, bounded adaptation, synthetic perturbation testing and tamper-evident provenance.

replacements.name: Resource-Aware Hybrid Model Orchestration Platform
replacements.summary: A private resource-aware orchestration platform for long-form generation and revision across local model runtimes with optional cloud supervision, explicit state, routing and recovery controls.

replacements.name: Biometric Systems Assurance Platform
replacements.summary: A vendor-neutral software assurance platform for synthetic biometric evaluation, adversarial testing, evidence generation, enterprise result ingestion and reproducible assurance workflows.

replacements.name: Evidence-Governed Software Assurance Platform
replacements.summary: A proprietary assurance control plane for discovering, auditing, qualifying, benchmarking, integrating and governing external software components under evidence-based policy.

additions.name: Software Asset Provenance & Qualification Platform
additions.summary: An evidence-driven qualification engine that binds repository provenance, dependency and license evidence, SBOM exports, vulnerability results, reproducibility receipts, signed attestations and external review records into a fail-closed software-asset qualification workflow.

additions.name: Adaptive General Reasoning Research Platform
additions.summary: A bounded research platform for evidence-gated general reasoning, active experimentation, latent structure discovery, uncertainty-aware planning and reproducible capability evaluation, with explicit non-AGI claim boundaries.

additions.name: TraceLine — Evidence-Governed Investigation Framework
additions.summary: A fail-closed decision-support and evidence-governance platform for professional private-investigation workflows, with persistent authorization records, evidence registries, audit-chain integrity and conservative legal/capability gating.

audit_notes.30: The repository uses the professional Resource-Aware Hybrid Model Orchestration Platform identity while its README still carries the historical Lewis Hybrid LLM Orchestrator product label.
audit_notes.37: The repository is now named Biometric Systems Assurance Platform while the README still carries the historical SentinelBio Verify product label. The portfolio uses the current repository identity.
audit_notes.41: The current repository identity and README are aligned as Evidence-Governed Software Assurance Platform.
audit_notes.54: The canonical Vision Evidence repository is currently an empty migration target; implementation continuity is evidenced by the separately retained legacy perception repository. This is a migration caveat, not proof of a fully populated canonical source tree.
audit_notes.67: TraceLine was empty in Release 20. It now contains a v0.3 executable Python core, governance/persistence layers, a local validation runner and multiple test modules. It is therefore included as a Verified Prototype, not as independently certified or field-validated software.
